description: Search menu items of Japanese restaurant chains and get their nutrition facts. Queries that return no results are counted anonymously (the query text and chain only) to decide which chains to add. query matches item name, size, category, genre and chain name (Japanese; spaces mean AND; katakana/hiragana and full/half width are treated alike; common chain nicknames like ケンタ, マック, サイゼ work). Combine with chain / genre / kcal range. Use nutrient to find items rich in a nutrient (only chains that publish it). With a query, results are sorted by how well the item name matches (default sort "relevance"); otherwise by kcal ascending. Each item has an id for sum_items, a page url, and the chain's source_file.

chain.description: Chain id from list_chains, or its Japanese name / nickname.

nutrient.description: Only items that publish this nutrient.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "牛丼 並盛", "チーズバーガー", "すき家 カレー".

name: search_menu
title: Search menu items
